order: claim-major, route-minor; F batch then afterok F+G batch; no between-arm policy edits
resource_basis: 48*120=5760s question cap + 1440s staging/load/4*45s synthetic-preflight margin. Prior job31645005 MaxRSS18527100K, 8CPU/32G/1A100 elapsed842s. Two serial batches; 96*120=11520s cannot fit one 2h allocation.
common_packing: max(original F prompt, empty-history G prompt, active actual prompt); actual billed tokens are not padded
initial_pair_gate: ordered visible sentence ID/hash and preview ID/hash exact equality; missing or unequal => no paired quality report, retain all costs
r2_comparison_boundary: Common packing is an additional predeclared change versus r2. Compare visible ordered IDs/hashes and token counts; r2 exact preview IDs were not recorded, so never claim full prompt equivalence or attribute F-r2 change only to grammar.
gap_policy: existing zero-shot evidence_gap_candidate, max160-character empty/exact immutable claim substring; no forced tool, answer/abstain legal; invalid span charged with concrete repair feedback
raw_storage: separate exclusive preflight and each slot; per slot 10 files; bytes=5*(wire_bound+16384); wire_bound=max(32768,512*max_token_UTF8_bytes+16); truncated/missing raw => reject audit and stop batch after durable cost record
scoring: After both inference children exit; original SciFact scorer, point diagnostic only, no bootstrap/p-value/independent-test claim; include failures/costs and raw->strict->event->next-feedback audit
source_identity: Both arms must use identical frozen source git/archive SHA recorded in externally approved submission receipt before first model call
